message.content: {"caption":"Diagram of an evolving memory architecture for language-model agents, from interaction-based note creation to linking, evolution, and retrieval.","description":"The diagram is organized into three stages. In Note Construction, an environment interacts with LLM agents through conversations; the interactions are processed into notes with attributes such as timestamps, content, context, keywords, tags, and embeddings. In Link Generation, the system retrieves top-k relevant memories and organizes linked notes into boxes. Memory Evolution shows memories being acted on and stored in updated boxes. In Memory Retrieval, a query is encoded and used to retrieve relevant memory, with related memories also supplied to an LLM agent.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
